address: Clevedon House, Ben Rhydding Drive, Ilkley,LS29 8AQ
bio: Situated in the heart of the Yorkshire countryside, The Clevedon at Ben Rhydding is an elegant venue serving quintessentially British Afternoon Teas.  Enjoy a range of sumptuous sweet and savoury treats, while admiring the sensational views of the Yorkshire countryside from the stunning terrace area.  Indulge in this delicious menu featuring classic features of the traditional Afternoon Tea such as finger sandwiches and homemade scones. Guests feeling in an extra decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of Prosecco, Pimms or even a gin and tonic that comes served in a china cup!  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
